        8                      Reverend Peter Young will now give

        9        us the invocation.

       10                      REVEREND PETER G. YOUNG:  Let us

       11        pray.  Father of poor, God of love, You made us

       12        all Your people.  We praise You and we thank

       13        You.  Fill us with a sense of justice.  Help us

       14        to do Your work, to take the side of the lowly,

       15        to defend the newcomer, to welcome the stranger.

       16        Help us now to be friend to the friendless, to

       17        protect the weak and work for the rights of all.

       18                      God, in our journey home, bring us

       19        together in peace and justice and in love. 
Amen.
